scope: Exact original aircraft job recovery after its executor ends
finding: Discovery offers the original job before new attack admission, but restart admission required a non-null matching target and a valid original lease before considering ended-worker retirement. Deleted targets or lost lease/group/epoch could leave the active job permanently marked without a live executor.
implementation: Exact original jobs can reuse the existing one-restart path despite deleted target identity, so original cleanup/egress runs without selecting a replacement contact.
An ended exact job with lost original flight lease/group/epoch retires through the existing guarded executor-failure cleanup and exact-token lease release.
An ended exact job with no pilot group also retires. A nonlocal group remains deferred as a possible ownership split.
Different requests cannot use this retirement; live workers retain their normal context-loss path. No new lease, deadline, controller, world query or timer.
The existing cleanup failure allowlist now admits FSM_RESTART_CONTEXT_LOST only under matching failed brain/job/generation/reason proof.
